concepts.name: NDA effective date
justifications: The agreement states that the Effective Date is 1 February 2027, distinct from the signing date of 29 January 2027.

concepts.name: NDA permitted purpose
predicted: evaluating a possible minority investment by the recipient in the discloser's marine sensor business under project glassfinch
gold: evaluating a possible minority investment by the recipient in the discloser's marine sensor business under project glassfinch.
values: Evaluating a possible minority investment by the Recipient in the Discloser's marine sensor business under Project Glassfinch
justifications: The sole Permitted Purpose is stated as evaluating a minority investment in the Discloser's marine sensor business under Project Glassfinch, with other activities excluded.

concepts.name: NDA disclosure window end
justifications: A valid termination notice closes the disclosure window effective 30 November 2027, earlier than the ordinary end date of 31 January 2028.

concepts.name: NDA contractual forum
justifications: The parties designate the courts of Oslo as their contractual forum under Norwegian governing law.

concepts.name: NDA signatory entities
justifications: FjordSignal AS is identified as a party registered in Norway under number 923 456 781 and acting as the Discloser.
Talus Ventures AB is identified as a party registered in Sweden under number 559123-4567 and acting as the Recipient.

concepts.name: Protected assets at the April snapshot
justifications: These four assets remain complete and unexcluded at the snapshot, since their exclusions cover only components or occur after the snapshot date. ORACLE is not protected because its late confirmation left protection suspended until acceptance on 8 April, and MICA is wholly excluded by independent development.

concepts.name: ORACLE timely confirmation deadline
justifications: Counting five Business Days from the Thursday 25 March 2027 call, skipping the excluded 26 and 29 March dates, gives a deadline of 5 April 2027 at 17:00 UTC.

concepts.name: ORACLE protection timeline
predicted: protection is not continuous. provisional protection for the oral oracle disclosure ran from the call on 25 march 2027 until the confirmation deadline of 5 april 2027 at 17:00 utc. the written confirmation was sent at 16:58 on 5 april but delivered only on 6 april at 09:05, so the provisional protection ended at the deadline. the recipient's written acceptance on 8 april at 10:00 restored protection prospectively only, leaving a gap from 5 april 17:00 utc to 8 april 10:00 utc. sending time is irrelevant; delivery to the designated mailbox governs timeliness.
gold: oracle is provisionally protected from the 25 march oral disclosure until 5 april 2027 at 17:00 utc. confirmation sent before that deadline arrived late on 6 april at 09:05, so protection lapses after the deadline. it resumes prospectively when the recipient expressly accepts on 8 april at 10:00 utc; the gap is not cured retroactively.
values: Protection is not continuous. Provisional protection for the oral ORACLE disclosure ran from the call on 25 March 2027 until the confirmation deadline of 5 April 2027 at 17:00 UTC. The written confirmation was sent at 16:58 on 5 April but delivered only on 6 April at 09:05, so the provisional protection ended at the deadline. The Recipient's written acceptance on 8 April at 10:00 restored protection prospectively only, leaving a gap from 5 April 17:00 UTC to 8 April 10:00 UTC. Sending time is irrelevant; delivery to the designated mailbox governs timeliness.
justifications: The protected periods, the gap, and the significance of sending versus delivery follow directly from the oral-information confirmation rule and the delivery rule.

concepts.name: Entire SHORE package excluded by prior possession
justifications: The prior-possession evidence covers only the older S-17 module, while the new branching map and thresholds in S-92 were first received on 20 February with no record of prior possession.

concepts.name: CEDAR end of protection
justifications: The Discloser's independent, lawful release of the entire CEDAR schedule to the unrestricted public on 15 June 2027 establishes the public-information exclusion for the whole schedule, ending protection from that date and overriding the longer duration periods.

concepts.name: People permitted LUMEN access at the September snapshot
justifications: Elin, Marek and Oskar each meet the role, undertaking, clean-room, security and competitor requirements as of the access snapshot. Marek's Talus Research employment qualifies because the Recipient's voting control there exceeds 50 percent, while Nora, Pia and Ravi do not qualify.

concepts.name: Talus Research qualifying voting percentage
justifications: Direct general shareholder votes of 48 percent plus a presently effective irrevocable proxy of 4 percent give 52 percent countable votes, while the revocable 6 percent is excluded.

concepts.name: Marek earliest authorised LUMEN access
justifications: Marek's clean-room approval is the last required condition and expressly becomes effective on 14 September, while his undertaking and security check were completed earlier and the voting arrangements operate by that date.

concepts.name: Executed competitor consent date for Pia
Q-27 notice deadline date
justifications: The notice prohibition was lifted on 5 July 2027 at 11:20, so the deadline is six continuous hours later (17:20 that day), which is earlier than the 6 July production time. The Section 2.4 after-hours deferral does not apply to this notice.

concepts.name: Q-27 notice lateness in minutes
justifications: The notice actually arrived at the Discloser's mailbox at 17:55 on 5 July 2027, against a 17:20 deadline. Compelled-disclosure notices are measured at actual arrival, giving 35 whole minutes of lateness.

concepts.name: Q-27 permitted production units
justifications: The final binding narrowing order requires all of P1 and only the non-privileged subsection P3A, while P3B is privileged and P2 and P4 were withdrawn. The portal production comprised P1 and P3A only.

concepts.name: WORK-1 deletion deadline
justifications: The return request was delivered on 22 November 2027 (before 17:00 UTC), so the ten-Business-Day period runs from that trigger, skipping the excluded 25 and 26 November dates. Restoration of WORK-1 does not restart the period.

concepts.name: BK-1 deletion deadline
justifications: The immutable backup may be kept only until the earlier of its scheduled overwrite (30 December 2027) and 45 calendar days after the 22 November 2027 trigger (6 January 2028), so the earlier date governs.

concepts.name: Artifacts permitted retention at the December snapshot
justifications: ARCH-1 is the segregated counsel-held archive under the compliance exception, BK-1 is the immutable backup still within its overwrite window, and HOLD-1 is the exact bundle under a binding preservation order at the snapshot. WORK-1 and NOTE-1 have no applicable exception.

concepts.name: NOTE-1 model training permitted as residual knowledge
justifications: Training a model on Confidential Information requires a separate signed licence, which does not exist, and the residual-knowledge permission excludes recorded notes and quantitative parameters. The custody retention clauses also do not authorise model training.
